exposure: Cervical ripening balloon (CRB) induction of labor
cohort: Women with previous cesarean section or grandmultiparity who underwent induction of labor with a cervical ripening balloon between January 2014 and March 2015 at Sarawak General Hospital
finding: The overall success rate of vaginal delivery after induction of labor with a cervical ripening balloon was 50%, but increased to about two-thirds in women with previous tested scars and unscarred, grandmultiparous women.
